_comment: Fixed local dataset for the compression accuracy-regression harness (adoption-headroom Phase 5, T016). Each fixture is read as text and run through the matching deterministic strategy. No live LLM call is involved -- 'accuracy preserved' is measured structurally: CCR round-trip completeness (reconstruct == original) for arrays and elided code bodies, plus signature-preservation rate for code. 'must_preserve' lists structural substrings (imports, decorators, class headers, function/method signatures) the CodeCompressor must keep verbatim in its skeleton.

fixtures.name: json_logs
fixtures.description: Repetitive log records with three change-points; SmartCrusher collapses the duplicate runs into reversible CCR markers.

fixtures.name: search_hits
fixtures.description: Search-result rows with a long identical run; SmartCrusher dedups it behind a CCR marker.

fixtures.name: python_module
fixtures.description: Imports, a dataclass, and a class with multi-line methods; CodeCompressor elides bodies behind CCR markers while keeping structure.

fixtures.name: typescript_module
fixtures.description: Imports, an interface, an exported function, and a class with a multi-line method; exercises the BRACE family (regex fallback works without tree-sitter).
